status: Prospective O1 benchmark specification, not an implemented trajectory generator or operational evidence.
legacy: Retain existing instantaneous clip labels, nominal5% primary and1% secondary; never retroactively relabel stable flags.
acceptance_role: User-agreed contract correction: this implemented and exercised advisory track, not the legacy all-stable clip flag budget, becomes decisive for the early-warning claim. The proposed1% clip misses/1% stable flags gate remains a research detection criterion, not advisory deployment acceptance. Keep stable/unstable margin tails and far-stable pessimism guardrails; define event/intervention/nuisance rules prospectively before policy scoring or selection.
population: Original TRAIN designs only for development, all paths/forcing/noise grouped by design. Frozen design partition seed1747:60% fit,20% policy/calibration,20% trajectory-held, with separate policy-selection and calibration halves inside the middle partition. Reserved project designs remain untouched.
dynamics: Integrate continuous state M qddot+C(V(t)) qdot+K(V(t))q=f(t) from existing assembled matrices. Full-order reference; fixed ROM permitted only after fixed-speed and ramp response comparison. No modal reset between windows, stitched clips, or growth clamp represented as exact physics. Quasi-steady piston theory only.
initial_conditions: One state draw per trajectory, seed1748/design/replicate; independently declared physical excitation and zero forcing thereafter except explicit pulses. Three initial-condition replicates; never choose from held failures.

profiles.slow_cross: V/ucrit:0.90 for5s; linear ramp to1.03 over30s; dwell10s
profiles.fast_cross: 0.90 for5s; linear ramp to1.03 over5s; dwell10s
profiles.approach_retreat: 0.90 for5s; linear ramp to0.995 over15s; dwell5s; retreat to0.90 over15s; dwell5s

acquisition: Fixed1000Hz physical sampling,512-sample trailing windows, update every100ms; sensor coordinates/calibration remain frozen. Verify retained response bandwidth is below400Hz before claiming this acquisition covers the population; otherwise report unsupported bandwidth, do not truth-adapt per trajectory. Normalize causally from a separate leading measured calibration period and hold physical channel scales fixed along each trajectory. Account for deployment mismatch versus per-clip calibration explicitly.
forcing_stress: Baseline initial-state excitation; weak critical-mode excitation and intermittent physical pulses as separate families. Critical-mode truth allowed only in simulator stress construction, never model inputs.
noise: Generate one continuous sample stream per trajectory/view: iid1/5 and rho.8 correlated1/5 controls; separate colored common interference, gain drift, impulses, and dropout sensitivity tracks. Shared overlapping samples. Levels normalized using a prospectively fixed calibration-record RMS, never future trajectory maximum or response RMS. Hardware PSD/units unavailable; sensitivity not realism.
advisory_contract: Stable precursor coverage measured for0<m<.01 on crossing trajectories, separately from instability detection. Neither near dwells nor retreat flags count automatically as useful anticipation. Crossing trajectories define frozen-time instability events at first V/ucrit>=1; harmful-amplitude events are separate and cannot be labeled until a physical response limit is supplied.
timeliness: Report delivered warning lead relative to first boundary crossing and the distribution of timely misses over a prespecified horizon grid0.5,1,2,5s. These are sensitivity horizons, not accepted intervention requirements. Application-specific recovery time and communication delay remain missing prerequisites for a real usable-lead acceptance gate.
alarm_episodes: Begin episode on first delivered positive decision; clear after five consecutive available negative updates (0.5s); unavailable updates do not clear or imply safe. Count clear/rearm transitions and flags separately. Report episodes/hour separately for safe dwell, near dwell, retreat and crossing paths. Only safe-dwell episodes are initially labeled nuisance; other contracts reported without automatic success/failure reinterpretation.
availability: Mark unavailable for missing/dropout input, failed modal identification, unsupported bandwidth, nonfinite estimates, or exceeded declared decision deadline; never convert to safe. Report unavailable duration and false-safe outputs during labeled crossing phases.
latency: Measure actual sensor-window-to-output p95/p99/max elapsed wall time, deadline miss fraction at100ms, timestamp delivery at window end+compute+declared communication delay; simulator/I/O excluded but acquisition window duration included in lead accounting. CPU hardware and concurrency recorded.
evaluation: Frozen clip candidates first; trajectory policies selected only on policy designs, nuisance episode thresholds calibrated only on calibration trajectories. Bootstrap whole designs with all paths/noise/initial conditions; no independent-window probabilities. Joint policy calibration required for warning unions. Event miss versus nuisance frontier, not per-condition chosen minima.
runtime_checks: Fixed-speed state-space response matches matrix exponential; integration step halving agrees on displacement/velocity and event time; ramp state continuous; overlapping noise samples exact; alarm state transitions including unavailable updates exercised; model outputs use measured trailing data only.
retesting: After benchmark, simulator, acquisition or decision implementation changes, rerun affected runtime checks and legacy comparison metrics; exercise actual propagated trajectories, causal overlapping windows and alarm clear/rearm/unavailable transitions. Specification edits do not constitute trajectory validation or operational evidence.
remaining_prerequisites: Implementation and runtime validation of continuous-state acquisition
Hardware noise PSD, physical sensor units, and bandwidth validation
claim_limit: Specification closes no operational evidence gap by itself. No lead-time, nuisance-alarm, availability or safety claims until trajectories and full inference are actually run.
